card.name: Letter P starting a split word
card.fires_on: A stray letter P (or p) that begins a word split off from the rest, such as P in Pregnant, Prolong, Proximal, or patient, often after a hyphen, colon, or capitalized IF.

modes.label: Capital P starting a word
modes.description: A separate capital P begins a word like Prolonged, Proximal, or Pregnant after a colon, dash, or IF.

modes.label: Lowercase p after hyphen or tag
modes.description: A lone p begins patient, potency, or palm right after a hyphen or odd break.

card.writes: It promotes word-continuation pieces and suppresses other word-start pieces, so it pushes the text toward finishing a P-word from its split-off first letter.
card.plain: It notices when a word starting with P has been cut so that the P stands alone, as in P-regnant or P-rolong.
